run_conda_writer: run conda_writer.py with an output directory to serialize all Faiss index types for backward compatibility testing
run_write_test_all_files: run write_test_all_files to generate serialized index files for all supported Faiss index types using a conda build
run_create_and_populate_index: run create_and_populate_index to build a Faiss index from a given index key and training vectors
run_create_and_populate_binary_index: run create_and_populate_binary_index to build a Faiss binary index from a given index key and binary vectors
run_test_write_index_type: run test_write_index_type to serialize a single Faiss index type to disk and return success or failure status
